text:
Alex Chen: taking primsec for the 23:00-07:00 UTC shift. handing off the ongoing KV cache tail latency incident. quick summary: 3 active alerts - kv_p99_tail, embeddings_queue_growth, region-eu-west-1-late. current primary/secondary - i'm primary, @Jamie Patel is secondary until 02:00 UTC, @Maria Gomez is t2 escalation point.

Jamie Patel: thanks. what are the immediate mitigation steps in flight? any customer-facing throttles applied?

Alex Chen: mitigation list: 1) evicting large prefix keys on eu-west cache nodes (in progress, script running on primsec pool) 2) embeddings ingestion queue backpressure enabled via rate-limit policy (applied globally but pinned to eu-west) 3) routing fallback enabled to us-west for < 10% of embeddings writes (controlled by feature flag). no global customer throttles yet. we did enable per-tenant soft limits for the top 5 noisy customers.

SRE Bot: INCIDENT ALERT: kv_p99_tail > 450ms on eu-west-1 (triggered at 4791123201). Current severity: P2. Pager sent to on-call.

Maria Gomez: I saw a few customer tickets coming in — mainly timeouts on infrequent batch jobs. CC'ing support: ticket numbers 17021,17022. They report retries succeed but with long delays. Notifying account execs for two affected mid-market customers.

Jamie Patel: thanks Maria. i'm taking point on the fallback routing check and will validate the us-west capacity before we escalate. quick checklist i'm following: - verify us-west GPU capacity and model variants - ensure KV prefix cache invalidation completed - confirm rate-limit headers are being honored downstream

Alex Chen: logs/commands i've been running: ```bash
# check eviction job status
kubectl logs eviction-job-eu-west -n redwood-infra | tail -n 200
# confirm routing feature flag
curl -sS https://config.redwood.internal/flags | jq '.routing.eu_west_to_us_west'
```

Jamie Patel: ran quick capacity check, us-west has ~12 spare GPUs in the pool (sufficient for small burst). i'll stand up an additional embedding worker if queue doesn't drain in 15m.

Maria Gomez: support update posted: "Customers may see intermittent +5-15s latency on bulk embedding jobs. We recommend retry/backoff. We're tracking root cause with SRE." added link to external status page draft: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4791123456-draft

Alex Chen: known coverage gap: automated KV eviction sometimes stalls when node rotates. playbook pointer: https://internal.redwood/wiki/playbooks/kv-eviction (runbook step 4b covers forced re-evict). if eviction stalls, run: ```bash
redwoodctl cache evict --prefix X --force
```

Jamie Patel: question — do we want to enable a temporary read-only fallback for heavy reads from affected tenants? could reduce load while we stabilize.

Alex Chen: yes, for the 2 noisy tenants i already set read-only via tenant flags. monitoring effects now.

SRE Bot: NOTE: canary rollback policy is enabled for the routing change. will auto-failback in 10m if error rate > 2% for routing fallback traffic.

Maria Gomez: i'm available for tier-2 escalations. i'll take incident ownership if pager escalates to P1. otherwise i'll coordinate with support and update customers every 30m.

Alex Chen: handoff notes for whoever receives this thread: - primary runbook: kv-eviction/playbook section - contact list: @Jamie (secondary), @Maria (t2), infra-oncall-rotation - mitigation timers: eviction job ttl 20m, fallback auto-failback 10m - customer impact: bulk embedding latency for a small set of mid-market tenants; no API-wide failures.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: primsec changed to Alex Chen at 23:00 UTC. Secondary: Jamie Patel until 02:00 UTC.

Jamie Patel: i'll post an update in 12m after the eviction job completes and routing check. ping me @Alex if anything breaks. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: cheers. leaving the thread open for the shift. if anything escalates call my cell +1-555-0199.
